info.title: TonicBridge
info.description: Operation Borderless: simulated wallets, no authentication or real funds. Monetary amounts are decimal strings. See docs/decisions.md. API responses use {statusCode, message, data, meta, errors}. History data is an array with total, limit, and offset in meta. Errors have null data and structured error details.
